meta.title: Unusual Feint
meta.description: After subduing the enemy, what remains is the light of dawn. Or is it—

units.rawText: The Oasis, outside the operand field.
units.displayText: The Oasis, outside the operand field.

spans.text: The Oasis, outside the operand field.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: Ahh...
units.displayText: Ahh...

spans.text: Ahh...

units.rawText: Hearing a familiar friend calling, Sol wrenches her eyelids open.
units.displayText: Hearing a familiar friend calling, Sol wrenches her eyelids open.

spans.text: Hearing a familiar friend calling, Sol wrenches her eyelids open.

units.rawText: Sol, you're finally awake!
units.displayText: Sol, you're finally awake!

spans.text: Sol, you're finally awake!

units.rawText: Woah!
units.displayText: Woah!

spans.text: Woah!

units.rawText: Feeling Persicaria's embrace, it all finally hit Sol—it was done.
units.displayText: Feeling Persicaria's embrace, it all finally hit Sol—it was done.

spans.text: Feeling Persicaria's embrace, it all finally hit Sol—it was done.

units.rawText: Suppose that "fortune favors the brave", waking up so quickly after all of that...
units.displayText: Suppose that "fortune favors the brave", waking up so quickly after all of that...

spans.text: Suppose that "fortune favors the brave", waking up so quickly after all of that...

units.rawText: Haha, I'll take that as a compliment, Anna...
units.displayText: Haha, I'll take that as a compliment, Anna...

spans.text: Haha, I'll take that as a compliment, Anna...

units.rawText: And now you're going to laugh? Look at yourself. There's not an inch of you that's not wounded, not to mention your right arm that doesn't even look remotely human!
units.displayText: And now you're going to laugh? Look at yourself. There's not an inch of you that's not wounded, not to mention your right arm that doesn't even look remotely human!

spans.text: And now you're going to laugh? Look at yourself. There's not an inch of you that's not wounded, not to mention your right arm that doesn't even look remotely human!

units.rawText: Sol?
units.displayText: Sol?

spans.text: Sol?

units.rawText: Remotely human... is that a pun?
units.displayText: Remotely human... is that a pun?

spans.text: Remotely human... is that a pun?

units.rawText: Antonina delivers a mighty forehead flick.
units.displayText: Antonina delivers a mighty forehead flick.

spans.text: Antonina delivers a mighty forehead flick.

units.rawText: I told you to get out if things didn't seem right, didn't I? I gave you that bomb, so what got into your head? Why didn't you use it?
units.displayText: I told you to get out if things didn't seem right, didn't I? I gave you that bomb, so what got into your head? Why didn't you use it?

spans.text: I told you to get out if things didn't seem right, didn't I? I gave you that bomb, so what got into your head? Why didn't you use it?

units.rawText: Hehe, saving munitions even through a decisive battle like that told you I was an intellectual!
units.displayText: Hehe, saving munitions even through a decisive battle like that told you I was an intellectual!

spans.text: Hehe, saving munitions even through a decisive battle like that told you I was an intellectual!

units.rawText: That's not a compliment. I'm being serious! If you didn't win at the end...
units.displayText: That's not a compliment. I'm being serious! If you didn't win at the end...

spans.text: That's not a compliment. I'm being serious! If you didn't win at the end...

units.rawText: I said that we'd all go back to the Oasis together.
units.displayText: I said that we'd all go back to the Oasis together.

spans.text: I said that we'd all go back to the Oasis together.

units.rawText: And if I ran away, all of that effort would've been for nothing. Can't you honestly say a nice thing or two?
units.displayText: And if I ran away, all of that effort would've been for nothing. Can't you honestly say a nice thing or two?

spans.text: And if I ran away, all of that effort would've been for nothing. Can't you honestly say a nice thing or two?

units.rawText: Faced with Sol's splendid smile, Antonina sighs in compromise.
units.displayText: Faced with Sol's splendid smile, Antonina sighs in compromise.

spans.text: Faced with Sol's splendid smile, Antonina sighs in compromise.

units.rawText: Sigh... thank goodness your luck is good...
units.displayText: Sigh... thank goodness your luck is good...

spans.text: Sigh... thank goodness your luck is good...

units.rawText: Haha, let's leave that for later. It is more than enough to see you awake, Sol.
units.displayText: Haha, let's leave that for later. It is more than enough to see you awake, Sol.

spans.text: Haha, let's leave that for later. It is more than enough to see you awake, Sol.

units.rawText: Here. This fell off during the battle.
units.displayText: Here. This fell off during the battle.

spans.text: Here. This fell off during the battle.

units.rawText: Sol sits still as Persicaria places the necklace back where it belongs. Even after weathering the fires of war, that shade of green inside was no less vibrant.
units.displayText: Sol sits still as Persicaria places the necklace back where it belongs. Even after weathering the fires of war, that shade of green inside was no less vibrant.

spans.text: Sol sits still as Persicaria places the necklace back where it belongs. Even after weathering the fires of war, that shade of green inside was no less vibrant.

units.rawText: Sol.
units.displayText: Sol.

spans.text: Sol.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Good job!
units.displayText: Good job!

spans.text: Good job!

units.rawText:
......
Woah, you've got a little bit of the Prof's touch, Persicaria! That was cool!
units.displayText:
......
Woah, you've got a little bit of the Prof's touch, Persicaria! That was cool!

spans.text:
......
Woah, you've got a little bit of the Prof's touch, Persicaria! That was cool!

units.rawText: I'm still a ways off, but I appreciate it.
units.displayText: I'm still a ways off, but I appreciate it.

spans.text: I'm still a ways off, but I appreciate it.

units.rawText: First aid's been done, so I'll have you go to Zone A with Antonina for in-depth treatment. She's off to maintain Zone A's Sandbox Barrier, and the medical team is close by.
units.displayText: First aid's been done, so I'll have you go to Zone A with Antonina for in-depth treatment. She's off to maintain Zone A's Sandbox Barrier, and the medical team is close by.

spans.text: First aid's been done, so I'll have you go to Zone A with Antonina for in-depth treatment. She's off to maintain Zone A's Sandbox Barrier, and the medical team is close by.

units.rawText: Persicaria, aren't you going to rest?
units.displayText: Persicaria, aren't you going to rest?

spans.text: Persicaria, aren't you going to rest?

units.rawText: There are some jellyfish remaining in the Oasis. I'll come look for you after they've been cleaned up. Antonina, Sol will be in your care.
units.displayText: There are some jellyfish remaining in the Oasis. I'll come look for you after they've been cleaned up. Antonina, Sol will be in your care.

spans.text: There are some jellyfish remaining in the Oasis. I'll come look for you after they've been cleaned up. Antonina, Sol will be in your care.

units.rawText: I'll be fine by myself...
units.displayText: I'll be fine by myself...

spans.text: I'll be fine by myself...

units.rawText: Those who have no care for their own safety have no right to speak.
units.displayText: Those who have no care for their own safety have no right to speak.

spans.text: Those who have no care for their own safety have no right to speak.

units.rawText: Disregarding Sol's protests, Antonina leads the squad towards the now peaceful outer ring of Zone A.
units.displayText: Disregarding Sol's protests, Antonina leads the squad towards the now peaceful outer ring of Zone A.

spans.text: Disregarding Sol's protests, Antonina leads the squad towards the now peaceful outer ring of Zone A.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Zone A Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Zone A Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: The Oasis, Zone A Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: We'll have to wait for a bit here. The medical team's sending someone over right now.
units.displayText: We'll have to wait for a bit here. The medical team's sending someone over right now.

spans.text: We'll have to wait for a bit here. The medical team's sending someone over right now.

units.rawText: They sure sound like they're busy...
units.displayText: They sure sound like they're busy...

spans.text: They sure sound like they're busy...

units.rawText: With this many wounded and the sudden change to our route, it's natural that these things don't get done as fast.
units.displayText: With this many wounded and the sudden change to our route, it's natural that these things don't get done as fast.

spans.text: With this many wounded and the sudden change to our route, it's natural that these things don't get done as fast.

units.rawText: You know, I'll be ok without rest, I can help out—
units.displayText: You know, I'll be ok without rest, I can help out—

spans.text: You know, I'll be ok without rest, I can help out—

units.rawText: Ah, never mind, never mind, I'll go and rest!
units.displayText: Ah, never mind, never mind, I'll go and rest!

spans.text: Ah, never mind, never mind, I'll go and rest!

units.rawText: Under Antonina's vicious gaze, Sol soon gives up the fight.
units.displayText: Under Antonina's vicious gaze, Sol soon gives up the fight.

spans.text: Under Antonina's vicious gaze, Sol soon gives up the fight.

units.rawText: Pfft—hahaha!
units.displayText: Pfft—hahaha!

spans.text: Pfft—hahaha!

units.rawText: A-Anna? Is there something up with your neural cloud? Don't scare me like that.
units.displayText: A-Anna? Is there something up with your neural cloud? Don't scare me like that.

spans.text: A-Anna? Is there something up with your neural cloud? Don't scare me like that.

units.rawText: Am I that scary? Was that all it took to get you shaking in your boots?
units.displayText: Am I that scary? Was that all it took to get you shaking in your boots?

spans.text: Am I that scary? Was that all it took to get you shaking in your boots?

units.rawText: Ehehe...
units.displayText: Ehehe...

spans.text: Ehehe...

units.rawText: I just think that...
units.displayText: I just think that...

spans.text: I just think that...

units.rawText: When I go think about it, everyone's grown so much...
units.displayText: When I go think about it, everyone's grown so much...

spans.text: When I go think about it, everyone's grown so much...

units.rawText: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.
units.displayText: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.

spans.text: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.

units.rawText: I can't stop moving forward, either.
units.displayText: I can't stop moving forward, either.

spans.text: I can't stop moving forward, either.

units.rawText: You—can't you say something?
units.displayText: You—can't you say something?

spans.text: You—can't you say something?

units.rawText: Hey, Anna, I know this isn't the best timing, but look over there.
units.displayText: Hey, Anna, I know this isn't the best timing, but look over there.

spans.text: Hey, Anna, I know this isn't the best timing, but look over there.

units.rawText: Huh, that area of the barrier looks a bit unstable...
units.displayText: Huh, that area of the barrier looks a bit unstable...

spans.text: Huh, that area of the barrier looks a bit unstable...

units.rawText: There are still some Entropics outside; look out!
units.displayText: There are still some Entropics outside; look out!

spans.text: There are still some Entropics outside; look out!

units.rawText: Antonina looks in the direction Sol gestures in. Some scattered Low Order Entropics continue to attack the barrier—with no chance of breaking through, but their efforts still cause the ground to tremble.
units.displayText: Antonina looks in the direction Sol gestures in. Some scattered Low Order Entropics continue to attack the barrier—with no chance of breaking through, but their efforts still cause the ground to tremble.

spans.text: Antonina looks in the direction Sol gestures in. Some scattered Low Order Entropics continue to attack the barrier—with no chance of breaking through, but their efforts still cause the ground to tremble.

units.rawText: They never give up, do they? Persicaria's going to have a field day... huh?
units.displayText: They never give up, do they? Persicaria's going to have a field day... huh?

spans.text: They never give up, do they? Persicaria's going to have a field day... huh?

units.rawText: (Sounds of gunfire)
units.displayText: (Sounds of gunfire)

spans.text: (Sounds of gunfire)

units.rawText: As lights in the distance flare up, the Entropics outside the barrier are swiftly turned into paste.
units.displayText: As lights in the distance flare up, the Entropics outside the barrier are swiftly turned into paste.

spans.text: As lights in the distance flare up, the Entropics outside the barrier are swiftly turned into paste.

units.rawText: Do we... have any expeditionary teams that are coming back?
units.displayText: Do we... have any expeditionary teams that are coming back?

spans.text: Do we... have any expeditionary teams that are coming back?

units.rawText: No, that's... the Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: No, that's... the Sanctifiers!

spans.text: No, that's... the Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: A great Sanctifier host appears on the horizon, and the Entropics in their path ground into dust.
units.displayText: A great Sanctifier host appears on the horizon, and the Entropics in their path ground into dust.

spans.text: A great Sanctifier host appears on the horizon, and the Entropics in their path ground into dust.

units.rawText: Woah... as expected of the Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: Woah... as expected of the Sanctifiers!

spans.text: Woah... as expected of the Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: Pfft... they really are awfully late. We've already taken care of the biggest problem there was.
units.displayText: Pfft... they really are awfully late. We've already taken care of the biggest problem there was.

spans.text: Pfft... they really are awfully late. We've already taken care of the biggest problem there was.

units.rawText: Faith's underlings helped us in Rossum, but we're yet to see whether these are friend or foe.
units.displayText: Faith's underlings helped us in Rossum, but we're yet to see whether these are friend or foe.

spans.text: Faith's underlings helped us in Rossum, but we're yet to see whether these are friend or foe.

units.rawText: Antonina regards the Fortitude that heads the Sanctifier group with wary eyes, powering up the Sandbox Barrier's defenses.
units.displayText: Antonina regards the Fortitude that heads the Sanctifier group with wary eyes, powering up the Sandbox Barrier's defenses.

spans.text: Antonina regards the Fortitude that heads the Sanctifier group with wary eyes, powering up the Sandbox Barrier's defenses.

units.rawText: [Beeeep—identity confirmed. Prepare to begin operation.]
units.displayText: [Beeeep—identity confirmed. Prepare to begin operation.]

spans.text: [Beeeep—identity confirmed. Prepare to begin operation.]

units.rawText: Fortitude slowly approaches the two, its immense frame an oppressive presence.
units.displayText: Fortitude slowly approaches the two, its immense frame an oppressive presence.

spans.text: Fortitude slowly approaches the two, its immense frame an oppressive presence.

units.rawText: [By the order of Lord Eosphorus, we are come to reinforce the Oasis.]
units.displayText: [By the order of Lord Eosphorus, we are come to reinforce the Oasis.]

spans.text: [By the order of Lord Eosphorus, we are come to reinforce the Oasis.]

units.rawText: [Here is a command certificate from Lord Eosphorus and Professor <cmdr>. Please allow us entry.]
units.displayText: [Here is a command certificate from Lord Eosphorus and Professor {교수}. Please allow us entry.]

spans.text: [Here is a command certificate from Lord Eosphorus and Professor
. Please allow us entry.]

units.rawText: ...The certificate is real.
units.displayText: ...The certificate is real.

spans.text: ...The certificate is real.

units.rawText: Looks like this "Eosphorus" really is something! Fantastic! We can finally take a load off!
units.displayText: Looks like this "Eosphorus" really is something! Fantastic! We can finally take a load off!

spans.text: Looks like this "Eosphorus" really is something! Fantastic! We can finally take a load off!

units.rawText: Sandbox barrier whitelist successful. I should tell Persicaria...
units.displayText: Sandbox barrier whitelist successful. I should tell Persicaria...

spans.text: Sandbox barrier whitelist successful. I should tell Persicaria...

units.rawText: The Fortitude leads the Sanctifier ranks into the Oasis. As they approach, a strange feeling of uneasiness takes root in Sol.
units.displayText: The Fortitude leads the Sanctifier ranks into the Oasis. As they approach, a strange feeling of uneasiness takes root in Sol.

spans.text: The Fortitude leads the Sanctifier ranks into the Oasis. As they approach, a strange feeling of uneasiness takes root in Sol.

units.rawText: All of a sudden, the light atop the Fortitude's head blinks. Sol's battle-honed mind reacts instantly—it was switching modes.
units.displayText: All of a sudden, the light atop the Fortitude's head blinks. Sol's battle-honed mind reacts instantly—it was switching modes.

spans.text: All of a sudden, the light atop the Fortitude's head blinks. Sol's battle-honed mind reacts instantly—it was switching modes.

units.rawText: ...Hang on, something's wrong!
units.displayText: ...Hang on, something's wrong!

spans.text: ...Hang on, something's wrong!

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: CLANG!
units.displayText: CLANG!

spans.text: CLANG!

units.rawText: Sol shoves Antonina off to the side. Before she came to her senses, the Fortitude's wicked claws stabbed into the earth where she stood.
units.displayText: Sol shoves Antonina off to the side. Before she came to her senses, the Fortitude's wicked claws stabbed into the earth where she stood.

spans.text: Sol shoves Antonina off to the side. Before she came to her senses, the Fortitude's wicked claws stabbed into the earth where she stood.

units.rawText: [Operation target detected, entering Capture Mode...]
units.displayText: [Operation target detected, entering Capture Mode...]

spans.text: [Operation target detected, entering Capture Mode...]

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: Run, Anna! They're not here to help us at all!!
units.displayText: Run, Anna! They're not here to help us at all!!

spans.text: Run, Anna! They're not here to help us at all!!

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: Hmm... this... goes here!
units.displayText: Hmm... this... goes here!

spans.text: Hmm... this... goes here!

units.rawText: This is go, not connect-four. Even if this game ends quickly, I'm not letting you go away.
units.displayText: This is go, not connect-four. Even if this game ends quickly, I'm not letting you go away.

spans.text: This is go, not connect-four. Even if this game ends quickly, I'm not letting you go away.

units.rawText: I already told you I don't know how this stuff works...
units.displayText: I already told you I don't know how this stuff works...

spans.text: I already told you I don't know how this stuff works...

units.rawText: Eucharist looks about with no small amount of visible grief on her face. The jellyfish in the room had long lost their luster, now in soft piles on the floor.
units.displayText: Eucharist looks about with no small amount of visible grief on her face. The jellyfish in the room had long lost their luster, now in soft piles on the floor.

spans.text: Eucharist looks about with no small amount of visible grief on her face. The jellyfish in the room had long lost their luster, now in soft piles on the floor.

units.rawText: Professor, I see the error of my ways. You see, the Oasis has taken out Ptolemaea, and I have no more forces to muster. Surely, in all your grace and greatness, you can show me some clemency, right?
units.displayText: Professor, I see the error of my ways. You see, the Oasis has taken out Ptolemaea, and I have no more forces to muster. Surely, in all your grace and greatness, you can show me some clemency, right?

spans.text: Professor, I see the error of my ways. You see, the Oasis has taken out Ptolemaea, and I have no more forces to muster. Surely, in all your grace and greatness, you can show me some clemency, right?

units.rawText: I doubt you've ever considered doing that for me before. I'm sending you off with the Sanctifiers, like it or not.
units.displayText: I doubt you've ever considered doing that for me before. I'm sending you off with the Sanctifiers, like it or not.

spans.text: I doubt you've ever considered doing that for me before. I'm sending you off with the Sanctifiers, like it or not.

units.rawText: Oh, that won't do...
units.displayText: Oh, that won't do...

spans.text: Oh, that won't do...

units.rawText: Eucharist surveys the great blockade of Sanctifiers outside of the watchtower, seemingly coming to a resolution.
units.displayText: Eucharist surveys the great blockade of Sanctifiers outside of the watchtower, seemingly coming to a resolution.

spans.text: Eucharist surveys the great blockade of Sanctifiers outside of the watchtower, seemingly coming to a resolution.

units.rawText: ...I'll put it this way. For an exchange to go through, one must provide something that is of value to the other side.
units.displayText: ...I'll put it this way. For an exchange to go through, one must provide something that is of value to the other side.

spans.text: ...I'll put it this way. For an exchange to go through, one must provide something that is of value to the other side.

units.rawText: I'll give you a valuable piece of intel, and you let me go. How about it?
units.displayText: I'll give you a valuable piece of intel, and you let me go. How about it?

spans.text: I'll give you a valuable piece of intel, and you let me go. How about it?

units.rawText: What intel could be more valuable than you yourself?
units.displayText: What intel could be more valuable than you yourself?

spans.text: What intel could be more valuable than you yourself?

units.rawText: What if I said... that the Oasis' survival hinges on this?
units.displayText: What if I said... that the Oasis' survival hinges on this?

spans.text: What if I said... that the Oasis' survival hinges on this?

units.rawText: The Oasis?
units.displayText: The Oasis?

spans.text: The Oasis?

units.rawText: I scrutinize Eucharist. She clasps her hands as if she had just gambled her very life, and her expression doesn't indicate that she is lying.
units.displayText: I scrutinize Eucharist. She clasps her hands as if she had just gambled her very life, and her expression doesn't indicate that she is lying.

spans.text: I scrutinize Eucharist. She clasps her hands as if she had just gambled her very life, and her expression doesn't indicate that she is lying.

units.rawText: You could afford to go into more detail.
units.displayText: You could afford to go into more detail.

spans.text: You could afford to go into more detail.

units.rawText: I do not mind continuing this back and forth with you here, Professor, but I am not the one who stands to suffer if the Oasis falls.
units.displayText: I do not mind continuing this back and forth with you here, Professor, but I am not the one who stands to suffer if the Oasis falls.

spans.text: I do not mind continuing this back and forth with you here, Professor, but I am not the one who stands to suffer if the Oasis falls.

units.rawText: How am I to believe you if you do not speak plainly?
units.displayText: How am I to believe you if you do not speak plainly?

spans.text: How am I to believe you if you do not speak plainly?

units.rawText: ...Alright. Looks like I'll need to put up some bait for you, Professor. Let's just say that this first hint of mine is a gift for you.
units.displayText: ...Alright. Looks like I'll need to put up some bait for you, Professor. Let's just say that this first hint of mine is a gift for you.

spans.text: ...Alright. Looks like I'll need to put up some bait for you, Professor. Let's just say that this first hint of mine is a gift for you.

units.rawText: Do you know why I was so confident back then, as if I wasn't worried in the slightest about the Sanctifier sent by the Reverse Babylon Tower?
units.displayText: Do you know why I was so confident back then, as if I wasn't worried in the slightest about the Sanctifier sent by the Reverse Babylon Tower?

spans.text: Do you know why I was so confident back then, as if I wasn't worried in the slightest about the Sanctifier sent by the Reverse Babylon Tower?

units.rawText: There are many possibilities. You are confident in your ability to escape, or you do not fear their capabilities in combat...
units.displayText: There are many possibilities. You are confident in your ability to escape, or you do not fear their capabilities in combat...

spans.text: There are many possibilities. You are confident in your ability to escape, or you do not fear their capabilities in combat...

units.rawText: But you see now that I'm sitting still here because I have no chance of escape, no?
units.displayText: But you see now that I'm sitting still here because I have no chance of escape, no?

spans.text: But you see now that I'm sitting still here because I have no chance of escape, no?

units.rawText: You mean to say... you have an inside man at the Reverse Babylon Tower?
units.displayText: You mean to say... you have an inside man at the Reverse Babylon Tower?

spans.text: You mean to say... you have an inside man at the Reverse Babylon Tower?

units.rawText: Bingo! Now, Professor, where do you think the garrison originally at this watchtower is currently?
units.displayText: Bingo! Now, Professor, where do you think the garrison originally at this watchtower is currently?

spans.text: Bingo! Now, Professor, where do you think the garrison originally at this watchtower is currently?

units.rawText: Are you talking about the Sanctifier forces dispatched to the Oasis? Eosphorus has said that the Sanctifiers will begin cooperation with the Oasis, which was verified by Faith.
units.displayText: Are you talking about the Sanctifier forces dispatched to the Oasis? Eosphorus has said that the Sanctifiers will begin cooperation with the Oasis, which was verified by Faith.

spans.text: Are you talking about the Sanctifier forces dispatched to the Oasis? Eosphorus has said that the Sanctifiers will begin cooperation with the Oasis, which was verified by Faith.

units.rawText: If we take a step back, even if the Sanctifiers were hostile to the Oasis, without my command, the Exiles would never allow them in.
units.displayText: If we take a step back, even if the Sanctifiers were hostile to the Oasis, without my command, the Exiles would never allow them in.

spans.text: If we take a step back, even if the Sanctifiers were hostile to the Oasis, without my command, the Exiles would never allow them in.

units.rawText: But what if they did?
units.displayText: But what if they did?

spans.text: But what if they did?

units.rawText: Commands can't be forged, unless if they have my signature...
units.displayText: Commands can't be forged, unless if they have my signature...

spans.text: Commands can't be forged, unless if they have my signature...

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: I suddenly realize something and spring to my feet.
units.displayText: I suddenly realize something and spring to my feet.

spans.text: I suddenly realize something and spring to my feet.

units.rawText: Signature collection complete. I hope you enjoyed this method of interaction.
units.displayText: Signature collection complete. I hope you enjoyed this method of interaction.

spans.text: Signature collection complete. I hope you enjoyed this method of interaction.

units.rawText: From today onward, there will be a brand new relationship between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis.
units.displayText: From today onward, there will be a brand new relationship between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis.

spans.text: From today onward, there will be a brand new relationship between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis.

units.rawText: Now then... I believe we will meet each other again very soon.
units.displayText: Now then... I believe we will meet each other again very soon.
